originalTitle: Is 'Trumpflation' real? Why Wall Street fears this could be a reason for stock market crash
simplifiedContent: There's a concern on Wall Street that the stock market might crash due to something called "Trumpflation". This refers to rising prices and inflation, which is currently at 3.3%. The Federal Reserve might respond to this by keeping interest rates high or even raising them, which could affect the value of stocks. This matters because if interest rates go up, it could make it more expensive for companies to borrow money, which could hurt their stock prices. As a result, investors are worried that the high values of stocks might not be sustainable.

originalTitle: World Bank's IFC, HDFC AMC invest in Molbio Diagnostics' Rs 281 crore IPO anchor round
simplifiedContent: Molbio Diagnostics, a company based in Goa, is planning to sell shares to the public through an Initial Public Offering (IPO) that will open on August 10. Before the IPO, the company raised Rs 281 crore from a few select investors, including the World Bank's investment arm and HDFC Mutual Fund. This is called an "anchor round" and it helps the company raise money before the IPO opens to the general public. The company also sold some existing shares worth Rs 160 crore to other investors. Major brokerages think this is a good investment opportunity and are recommending that people buy the shares.

originalTitle: Market Trading Guide: Jindal Saw among 2 stock recommendations for Monday
simplifiedContent: Here's a simplified version of the news: Some companies in the stock market have recently reported their earnings, and most of them have done as well as or better than expected. This is good news for specific sectors of the market. As a result, there's a positive feeling about these sectors right now. The article suggests that Jindal Saw is one of two stocks that might be a good choice to consider buying on Monday. This could be a good opportunity for investors, but it's always important to do your own research before making any decisions.

originalTitle: The stock market is finally rising again—and it’s getting cheaper, too
simplifiedContent: The stock market, which is like a big list of companies, is doing well and its value is going up. In fact, a group of big companies called the S&P 500 has increased in value by 22% over the past year. Even though the market is going up, the prices of these companies are actually becoming more affordable, which is a good thing for people who want to invest. This is because the valuations, or the measures of how expensive these companies are, have decreased. This change could be a positive sign for investors, as it means they might be able to buy into the market at a more reasonable price.

originalTitle: Upcoming IPOs: Shiprocket IPO, Dhoot Transmission IPO among new issues to open next week; full list here
simplifiedContent: Some new companies, including Shiprocket and Dhoot Transmission, are planning to sell their shares to the public for the first time through an Initial Public Offering (IPO). This means people can buy their shares starting from August 10 to 12. At the same time, shares of eight other companies that were recently available for purchase will start trading in the market. This is important because it gives investors new options to consider when deciding where to put their money. These new IPOs and market debuts can provide opportunities for investors to buy into new companies and potentially earn returns.

originalTitle: Defence stock Apollo Micro Systems declares Q1 results 2026. Revenue jumps 88% YoY to  ₹251 crore, PAT up 43%
simplifiedContent: Apollo Micro Systems, a company that makes products for the defense industry, just announced its financial results for the first quarter of 2026. The company's revenue, which is the amount of money it made from selling its products, increased by 88% compared to the same time last year, reaching ₹251.3 crore. Its profit, which is the amount of money it made after paying all its expenses, also increased by 43% to ₹25.2 crore. This is a significant increase and suggests that the company is doing well. This matters because it can affect the company's stock price and influence investors' decisions to buy or sell its shares.
